text:
elena: Quick thread 1: We shipped the new launch messaging yesterday and Pulse shows uplift in clicks but landing bounce rate spiked. Can we sanity-check the landing variants?

ben: which variant are you seeing? A/B tool shows 60/40 split: variant_b is the new copy.

esophia: I pulled server logs — variant_b had an error rate bump for 302 redirects. looks like our redirect rule for /lp-old -> /lp-new didn't include the query string, so UTM params dropped.

micah: that would explain higher bounce — sessions lose context and we serve a generic page.

elena: can someone patch redirect to preserve querystring? Also add a quick metric: percent_with_utm on landing.

insights-bot: detected change: redirect rule updated by infra-deploy at 09:30 UTC. commit: preserve-querystring=true.

ben: rolled fix in canary at 09:32, full rollout at 09:38.

esophia: ran a quick check: before fix percent_with_utm=62%, after fix=95% for variant_b.

elena: great. action: 1) hold next messaging push (variant_b second push) until we validate 24h of normalized conversion, 2) analytics to re-run cohort attribution for noon snapshot.

micah: added gating rule to campaign scheduler: require percent_with_utm > 90% for 2 consecutive hours to auto-publish wave 2.

ben: +1. will also add an alert on landing bounce > 50% for any campaign.

elena: for Monday KPI, include a before/after microcase study slide showing how a redirect bug created false negative for the messaging test. That helps the team learn and reduces panic on numbers.

insights-bot: scheduled backfill job JOB-20260321-02 for attribution rejoin. estimated run: 20m.

ben: uploading corrected metrics to the drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-metrics/variant_fix.png

elena: thanks. I'll summarize in the KPI thread and mark it as resolved once backfill completes. :thumbsup:
